places.name: Kudle Beach
places.blurb: A picturesque crescent-shaped beach popular for relaxing, yoga, and seaside shacks.

places.name: Om Beach
places.blurb: Famous shaped like the auspicious Om symbol and offering water sports and scenic sunset views.

places.name: Half Moon Beach
places.blurb: A secluded cove accessible only by a trek or boat ride, perfect for tranquility.

places.name: Paradise Beach
places.blurb: The southernmost beach of Gokarna known for its pristine sands and rocky coastline.

places.name: Mirjan Fort
places.blurb: A historic 16th-century laterite fort covered in lush green moss and overgrowth.

places.name: Yana Caves
places.blurb: Unique black karst rock formations set deep within the evergreen forests of the Western Ghats.

places.name: Unchalli Falls
places.blurb: A breathtaking waterfall plunging down into a deep gorge amidst thick forest surroundings.

places.name: Jog Falls
places.blurb: One of India's highest plunge waterfalls, cascading majestically on the Sharavathi River.
